# Rules and tuning

_Generated from `scripts/core/data.gd`, `scripts/match/life.gd`, `content/rules`, `content/combos`._

## Expedition tiers

| Tier | Monsters | Loot | Wild Boki levels | Unlocks after | Boki at risk | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Meadow | x1 | x1 | 1 to 3 | 0 extractions | no | Gentle islands. Your Boki are always safe here: lose your loot, never your Boki. |
| Dusk Isles | x1.45 | x1.75 | 2 to 5 | 2 extractions | no | Tougher monsters, more loot, rarer Boki. Your Boki is always safe here: it goes home with you if you fall. |
| The Hollow | x2 | x2.75 | 4 to 8 | 5 extractions | dropped dazed, can be scanned | Brutal and rich. If you fall your Boki drops dazed beside your deathbox and guards it. Get revived and run into it to pick it up, or a rival can scan it and take it (knock it out, then hold the interact key). |

## Match

| Setting | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| players | 20 | hunters in an expedition (solos, duos or trios) |
| length | 360 | seconds until the islands fall |
| down_hp | 100 | so about 40 seconds downed before you bleed out |

## Down, death and revive

From `Life.R` (`scripts/match/life.gd`); the full flow is on [Expeditions](Expeditions.md).

| Rule | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| bleed_out | 15 | seconds a wisp lasts on its own |
| revive_radius | 1.6 | a teammate this close revives you |
| revive_time | 4 |  |
| revive_hp | 0.25 | back on your feet with a quarter of your health |
| extra_reviver | 0.5 | each extra teammate on you: +50% speed |
| stomp_mult | 2.5 | an enemy standing on a wisp drains it this much faster and blocks the revive |
| stomp_slow | 0.4 | ...and pins it: the wisp drifts at this fraction of its normal speed |
| execute_time | 3 | (old: hold interact on an enemy wisp; now the stomp below) |
| stomp_commit | 0.2 | hold interact this long on an enemy wisp to start the stomp... |
| stomp_time | 2.4 | ...then you're locked in for this long, three stomps and done |
| stomp_cycle | 0.7 | one foot-lift-and-slam |
| kin_revive_time | 8 | your kin pulling you up (as long as Supervive's Guardian Angel self-revive) |
| box_revive_hp | 0.25 | same as a wisp revive |
| soul_time | 90 | box revive window |
| loot_time | 1 | bots: hold interact to take everything from a box (you get a loot window) |
| sickness_time | 12 | resurrection sickness |
| sickness_dmg | 0.75 | -25% damage dealt |

## boki_lines (`content/rules/boki_lines.json`)

What Boki say (BokiLines, docs/BOKI_TALK.md). tuning: max_words = the most words in one bubble (punctuation and symbols don't count); act_words = the most words in one action, which a young Boki says after its name; bubble_s = seconds a bubble stays up; cooldown_s = seconds a Boki waits between lines (a trigger marked direct answers something you did and skips the wait); no_repeat = how many of its own last lines a Boki never repeats; min_lines = the fewest general lines a trigger may have; grown_stage = the speech stage (Care.speech) from which a Boki says lines instead of its name. tones = how a young Boki says its name, by feeling ({A} first syllable, {a} lower, {b} second syllable, {F} full name, {f} lower, {U} upper; KinSpeak.fill). sounds = noises a tone may use besides the name. alias = old trigger names that share another's lines. triggers: feel (a tone), word (the one word a stage-1 Boki adds), acts (what it does), lines._ (anyone) and lines.<element> (extra lines for a Boki of that element, the species' type).

## Bond meter (`content/rules/bond.json`)

How the bond meter fills (it gates the Merge). All values are fractions of a full meter. Your Boki's hits mark the foe for mark_s seconds, and your own hits on a marked foe fill the meter marked_factor times faster. (Every point of damage you or your Boki deal also adds 1/320, see Match.on_damage.)

|---|---|
| per_player_dmg | 0.0016 |
| per_kin_dmg | 0.0026 |
| passive_per_sec | 0.002 |
| combo | 0.05 |
| kin_ko | 0.06 |
| max_per_hit | 0.035 |
| kin_required | True |
| mob_factor | 0.6 |
| marked_factor | 2 |
| mark_s | 4 |

## breakables (`content/rules/breakables.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | Everything you can smash (scripts/match/breakables.gd). Any single hit breaks a breakable: a shot, a melee swing, an ability, a Boki strike, a blast or a dash through it; none has a health pool. 'weight' is the share of the random scatter on a map. 'material' picks the debris colours (see 'debris') and the break sound. 'loot' is rolled when it breaks: gems [min, max] worth gem_base each, odds for a tonic, armor shards (armor_amount) and a seed, and 'table' names a gear drop table. An 'explosive' kind is lit by its hit instead, burns 'fuse' seconds (or 'chain_fuse' when another blast lit it) with a ground ring showing 'radius', then blows: 'damage' at the middle falling to half at the edge, knockback and lift in m/s, 'shake' camera trauma. |

## class_unlock (`content/rules/class_unlock.json`)

Hunter unlocks and mastery (docs/decisions/0005). A new save wears Vex first (`starters`, picked on the first-Mask screen, free at the first portal) and plays the tutorial as Vex. After its first finished expedition the player picks one of `second_picks` as the second Mask; the other two open through their own challenges, like Lisette. Every other Hunter opens through its own challenge in `unlock`, counted across all your expeditions whoever you play; a challenge with `after` also waits until that many Hunters are open. A done challenge never opens a Hunter by itself: the player holds the button on the Hunters screen for `hold_s` seconds. `mastery` lists each Hunter's goals, counted only in expeditions played as that Hunter; each one done is a mastery level and a cosmetic reward. Rewards are cosmetic only (`reward_kinds`). Ids are Hunter ids, never display names. Every number is a placeholder until the owner tunes it.

## dash_feel (`content/rules/dash_feel.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Global feel for every hunter's dash (Shift), applied on top of each kit's own numbers in content/archetypes. dist: multiplier on distance. time: multiplier on duration (speed = dist / time). Owner, Nov 2: dashes were too fast and too far in general, Ryzz's should go further: its lane is drawn from its own numbers, so its distance is raised in content/archetypes/mage.json (4-7m to 5-8.5m) and only its time is scaled here. Dancer (thief) is taken off it: her Cartwheel is the source's measured one (owner review item 7: 4.5m in 0.48s on the ground, 8.4m over 0.95s from a jump), set as-is in content/archetypes/thief.json. |

| mage | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.15} |
| thief | {"dist": 1.0, "time": 1.0} |

## farm_build (`content/rules/farm_build.json`)

The farm building pass (docs/decisions/0004-farm-building.md). Farm level is points from play; items unlock by farm level or a milestone; new buildings are construction sites that you hammer (hold interact) and your Boki help build; the materials are spent a quarter at a time as the work goes; buildings upgrade L1 to L3. Units: gems and materials are counts, labour is work swings (one hammer beat of yours is 0.8 s, one swing of a Boki is about 3 s at building skill 1).

|---|---|

| points_doc | Farm points = sum(stat * weight). 'built' counts the lot buildings you built, 'fb_built' the buildings Boki finished on the farm. |

## farm_builder (`content/rules/farm_builder.json`)

Hob Brackenridge, the farm's builder (docs/decisions/0011-farm-builder-tutorial.md). He stands by the market stall (and works at the house while it goes up); walk up and press interact to talk face to face ('talk'). Blueprints with a level or milestone in farm_build.json unlock for real only once Hob has drawn them up, so a level-up or milestone makes a 'new blueprints' toast and a mark over his head. Everything with no entry there is on offer from the start.

## mantle_look (`content/rules/mantle_look.json`)

The Mantle look (docs/decisions/0011-mantle-look.md). In a match a Bearer looks like the class's original Warden (`wardens`: gender, folk, face, hair, palette; the class's gear and silhouette come from the archetype), nudged by the player's own person (Save look, PlayerLook). Each slider (0..1, 0.5 = neutral) moves its model factor by at most `sliders.<key>.clamp` either way (a Warden's own `clamp` block overrides it); at home the player is their own person, with `own_k` times that range and their own colours. Each colour pick pulls the Warden's colour `pull` of the way in HSV, never more than `hue` / `sat` / `val` (a Warden's `tint` block overrides it), so signature colours stay. Hitboxes never read any of this. `presets` set the face sliders as a starting point. Gender is the base character's (OWNER_REVIEW item 39; 'robot' builds on the male body).

## mask_moment (`content/rules/mask_moment.json`)

Putting on a Mask (MaskBeat, scripts/ui/mask_beat.gd): build-up, the Mask rising to the face, a cut to black and silence, flashes of the fallen Hunter with a whisper, the snap back with an impact and a ripple of light, a pose, the name and title, and a sting. Times in seconds. 'full' is the first Mask (and every first time); 'short' is a later Mask on the farm. After the first one the player can skip.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| full | {"build_s": 1.2, "rise_s": 1.4, "black_s": 0.7, "memory_s": [0.3, 0.28, 0.36], "reveal_s": 1.6, "push_in": 0.7} |
| short | {"build_s": 0.5, "rise_s": 0.8, "black_s": 0.45, "memory_s": [0.38], "reveal_s": 1.5, "push_in": 0.6} |
| times_doc | build_s: the world quiets, the camera eases in, swell and heartbeat. rise_s: the Mask lifts to the face in slow motion while a ghostly porcelain face flickers over yours. black_s: the hard silence after contact. memory_s: one entry per memory frame of the fallen Hunter (their painted art). reveal_s: the snap back to the end (pose, name and title, sting). push_in: how far the camera eases in (0..1 of the way to the face). |
| music_duck_db | -30 |
| heart_gaps_s | [0.62, 0.5, 0.4, 0.32] |
| punch_fov | 5 |

Feed it, or it feeds on you.", "archer": "Every Mask I sewed, I will cut loose.", "bulwark": "Hold on. The shore is close.", "mage": "One day I give the storm back.", "ashwick": "Bottled Blight. ## warden_look (`content/rules/warden_look.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | A Warden 3D model's own shading over the shared painted look (WardenGlb.look), keyed by the model's art name (art/wardens/<art>/<art>.glb; a design variant has its own key). painted: hero_toon.gdshader parameters on all of its surfaces, set after WardenGlb.PAINTED. slots: the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, eyes, glow), after painted. Colours are [r, g, b]. A model without an entry keeps the shared look. Useful keys: rim_far and rim_far_color (a rim in the Hunter's signature colour at the match camera), top_light (surfaces facing up lift), fres and fres_tint (the coloured rim; 1 = lightened own colour), far_lift (brighter and richer at the match camera), shade and shadow_tint (the shadow floor and its tint), sheen, glow (emission x the painted colour), light_neutral_warm (takes the hue out of warm lights too: black cloth and gunmetal stay black and grey under an orange sun). halos: glow discs of a constant size on screen on the model's anchors (a lens a pixel wide at the match camera): anchor, color, strength, px (radius on screen), near and far (m: none this close, full from there; close-ups keep the lens itself). albedo: a colour multiplier on the slot's atlas, applied on top of the player's colour pick (it never replaces the pick). Match zoom (the shared far_* look, WardenGlb.PAINTED; set these per model only to tune it): far_fres (the pale fresnel's share left at the match camera, 0.35), far_spec (gloss, sheen and the lights' rims there, 0), far_clamp (stray texels pulled to their coarser mip, 0.8), far_rim_soft (1: rim_far is a broad saturated band in rim_far_color; keep rim_far 0.25-0.35), far_glow (whatever glows a step brighter there, 0.6). no_ink: material tags or slots drawn without the ink shell (e.g. ["gum", "crossbow"]). ink: the model's own ink shell, far_thin (0.8), far_cut (0.55: gone from ~13.5 m; 0 keeps it), color. glow_shell: the glow slot's halo at the match camera (glow_px 1.4 screen px, glow_k 1.3, glow_near 7, glow_far 14 m, glow_col; {"glow_px": 0} for none). A card slot's far keys (shaders/warden_card.gdshader, under slots.card): far_sheen 0, far_edge 1, far_alpha 1.35. the same per toon slot (skin, hair, cloth, leather, metal, brass, eyes, glow), after painted; a "<slot>-<tag>" key (hair-braid: the woven braids) after its slot. paint_glow, paint_glow_color and paint_glow_width: texels of that painted colour glow (a skin's tattoos at night). weapon_scale: a size multiplier on the held .glb weapon (Kael 0.85, owner Nov 4); weapon_offset: [x, y, z] metres that move it in the Gun's space (seats the grip in the hand: Lisette's bow). |

## warden_stance (`content/rules/warden_stance.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| doc | Each Warden's signature stance on the shared rig (scripts/match/warden_stance.gd), keyed by archetype id. gait: how the body stands and moves over its class (HunterAnim.STANCE keys: knee, width, lean, bounce, arm, elbow, cadence, stride, fidgets). pose: offsets on the rig's bones, full in idle and blended into run, aim and abilities at the blend weights below. spine: forward lean (rad, + forward). tilt: the shoulders drop toward the weight leg (rad). twist: the shoulders turn (rad, + left). hip: the hips shift over the weight leg (m). lift: the body up (m, + up). back: the hips back (m). knee: extra bend in both knees (rad). spread: the legs wider apart (rad). free_leg: the free leg's hip (+ forward) and knee bend (rad). head: pitch (+ chin up), yaw (+ left), roll (+ toward the left shoulder) (rad). arm_l: the free left hand's place from its rest (m, model space: x right, y up, z back). carry: the weapon's idle place under Aim, pos (m) and rot (pitch, yaw, roll, rad), free_l 1 to let the left hand off it (free_r 1: the right, for a weapon carried in the left hand); it blends to the aim pose the moment the Warden fires. leg: the weight leg (l or r). idle: breath (rate, rad/s), breath_amp (x the breathing), shift (s on the weight leg before a short shift to the other), fidget (every and dur in s; body, head, hip and gun offsets at the fidget's peak, wave times over). |

## weapon_path (`content/rules/weapon_path.json`)



| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| _doc | The fixed weapon path (scripts/match/weapon_path.gd): on every even level (2, 4, 6, 8, 10) a hunter's signature weapon takes the next step on its hero's path, with no choice to make. Each step is a plain weapon upgrade id from Data.PERKS (WeaponUps: hotload = damage, deepmag = magazine (only Vex: no other hero weapon has ammo), quickfeed = fire rate, longreach = range). One entry per hero in Arch.ORDER. Brands are not on the path: they come from perk orbs. If an orb already maxed a step, the next open plain upgrade is taken instead. default is for a hunter with no hero. |
| default | ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"] |
| paths | {"thief": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "archer": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "mage": ["hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload"], "gunslinger": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "deepmag", "hotload", "longreach"], "juggernaut": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload"], "bulwark": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "dredge": ["hotload", "hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed", "longreach"], "ashwick": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "hotload", "quickfeed"], "tender": ["quickfeed", "hotload", "hotload", "longreach", "hotload"], "rimewright": ["hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach"], "dolm": ["hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload", "longreach", "quickfeed"], "ostra": ["hotload", "longreach", "hotload", "quickfeed", "hotload"]} |

## Combos

One fighter sets a foe up with a status, the partner pays it off (`content/combos/`).

| Combo | Shows | Set up by | With | Paid off by | Window | Bonus | Bond |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Combo | COMBO | your Boki | stun, root | you | 2.5s | +35% | +5% of a meter |
| Kindling | FLARE | anyone | burn | your Boki's ability | 3s | +25% | +3% of a meter |
| Pounce | POUNCE | you | stun, slow | your Boki | 2.5s | +60% | +4% of a meter |
